Give Back Beauty is a privately owned beauty group that collaborates with brands and talents through global partnerships, licensing agreements, joint ventures, and worldwide distribution. Guided by our motto “Big enough to matter, small enough to care,” our goal is to build brands with a long-term vision—always with a focus on giving back to people and the planet. About the role We are looking for a Brand Manager Italy to join our Go-to-Market team and drive the growth and success of a portfolio of premium beauty and lifestyle brands in the Italian market. reporting directly to the Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for developing and executing local brand strategies, ensuring best-in-class market execution, and collaborating closely with international, sales, trade marketing, and finance teams. You will play a key role in shaping brand performance, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering impactful marketing initiatives while leading and developing a small marketing team. Key responsibilities Develop and execute local go-to-market strategies in alignment with global brand objectives. Collaborate with international teams to ensure flawless execution of marketing plans while identifying local market opportunities and sharing best practices. Manage and monitor the marketing budget for assigned brands in partnership with the Finance team. Work closely with Sales and Trade Marketing teams to maximize brand visibility and commercial performance. Analyze market trends, market share, sales performance, and ROI of marketing investments to drive business decisions. Lead forecasting activities in collaboration with Demand Planning and Sales teams. Deliver compelling launch presentations and ongoing brand updates to commercial teams and retail partners. Manage and develop a team composed of a Junior Brand Manager and an Assistant Brand Manager. What we are looking for 3- 5 years of experience in Brand Management or Marketing, ideally within the beauty, cosmetics, fashion, or FMCG industry. Strong passion for brands, products, innovation, and consumer trends. Proven ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. Excellent analytical skills with a data-driven mindset and strong business acumen. Entrepreneurial attitude, proactive approach, and strong problem-solving capabilities. Collaborative team player with strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Fluency in Italian and English is required. What we offer Annual gross salary range: €38.000 – €40.000 + 10% variable bonus. Hybrid working model with up to 2 days of remote working per week. €8 meal vouchers for each working day. Opportunity to shape and drive e-commerce excellence across markets. Dynamic and collaborative international environment. Partner closely with Retail, Marketing, Events and CVM teams to ensure a consistent, elevated and commercially impactful client experience across all European markets. Drive the execution and governance of strategic client engagement initiatives, ensuring operational excellence, alignment with brand standards and seamless coordination across regional markets and headquarters. Monitor client engagement performance, VIC development and ROI of initiatives, leveraging insights to continuously optimize engagement strategies and maximize both client loyalty and business impact." You’re skilled in understanding luxury retail environments, clienteling dynamics, and VIC engagement strategies, with a strong sensitivity to the codes and expectations of the luxury industry. You’re known for exceptional interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to develop trusted relationships with UHNW clients and key stakeholders across the luxury ecosystem, and it shows in how you work with others. You’re skilled in project management, with the ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders. Strategic and creative mindset, with the ability to translate brand values into meaningful and memorable client experiences. You’re known for your analytical mindset with the ability to measure performance, client impact, and ROI of engagement initiatives. You’re known for being highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of working autonomously in a fast-paced international environment. You communicate fluently in English and Italian (mandatory).
